data.name: Manvik
data.gender_notes: Manvik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manvik is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘manas’ (mind) and ‘vij’ (wisdom or intellect). This name signifies a person who possesses a strong mind and vast intellect. It is also believed to be a name of Lord Vishnu. The name Manvik carries the meaning “Mind, intellect, wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manvik usually hope their child will grow to embody mind, intellect, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes wisdom and intellectual growth.
data.etymology: Manvik belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mind, intellect, wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manvik total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
